title: fpvsim-map v1
description: A map package for fpv-sim (map.json). Units: metres and degrees. Frame: ENU (x east, y north, z up). See docs/MAP_FORMAT.md.

id.description: Unique id; equals the package folder name.

license.description: SPDX licence id or expression covering the whole package (accepted ids: docs/MAP_FORMAT.md).

version.description: Semantic version of the map itself.

size.description: Half-extent of the playable area (m); the terrain mesh covers 2.2 x this.

elevationM.description: Altitude above sea level (air density, barometer).

pos.description: Spawn point; the quad is placed on the floor below it.

yawDeg.description: Heading, degrees counter-clockwise from east: 0 = east, 90 = north.

groundZ.description: Floor height at the spawn (default: terrain height).

pilot.description: Pilot / video receiver position (default: 2 m south-west of the spawn, 1.6 m above the terrain).

sky.description: Sky and ambient light. night: a dark sky lit by the moon (the sun direction) and the map's lights.

directionDeg.description: Direction the wind blows FROM, clockwise from north.

wind.description: The wind this map suggests: used by scenarios that set no wind, and offered in the live game.

ground.description: Terrain under everything (default: flat at z = 0, or that of the Quake / Doom geometry).

visible.description: Draw the terrain mesh (false: collision only).

texture.description: Ground texture (repeats every 3 m); default from material.

image.description: Greyscale PNG (8 or 16 bit), 2..1025 px per side. Pixel (0, 0) is the north-west corner.

visible.description: Draw the terrain mesh (false: collision only).

texture.description: Ground texture (repeats every 3 m); default from material.

visible.description: Draw the terrain mesh (false: collision only).

texture.description: Ground texture (repeats every 3 m); default from material.

scale.description: Feature size (m): noise is sampled at (x / scale, y / scale).

mask.description: Fade the layer from 0 at distance "from" to 1 at "to" (square: Chebyshev distance).

material.description: Physical surface: restitution, friction, stiffness and prop damage on impact (src/sim/contact.ts MATERIALS).

tag.description: Free-form label ("tank" and "gate*" have special rendering).

size.description: Full size [x, y, z] (m) before rotation.

pitchDeg.description: Then rotation about the box's own y axis.

texture.description: Texture image (world-scaled, repeats every 2 m); overrides visual.

text.description: banner / screen: text to print on the board

material.description: Physical surface: restitution, friction, stiffness and prop damage on impact (src/sim/contact.ts MATERIALS).

oneOf.description: Vertical; pos = centre of the base. Default material metal.

tag.description: Free-form label ("tank" and "gate*" have special rendering).

pos.description: [x, y] standing on the terrain, or [x, y, z]; dive gates need z (frame height).

yawDeg.description: Rotation about +z. At 0 the gate spans east-west and is flown through northwards.

width.description: Opening (m). Defaults: square / dive / flag 1.524, arch 3.0.

stack.description: ladder: number of stacked openings (only the top one counts)

onTop.description: the gate sits on the gate below it (no legs / bottom bar), e.g. a split-S stack

wakeZones.description: Obstacles (building / tree line footprint) that shed a wake downwind: shelter, lee downdraft, roof-edge updraft and turbulence.

indoor.description: Enclosed spaces (axis-aligned boxes): the wind inside is scaled by windScale (default 0.1).

lights.description: Point lights (interior fixtures, floodlights), at most 8. The illuminance at distance d is about intensity / d² (the sun is about 4.5).

geometry.description: External geometry. At most one quake or doom entry.

anyOf.description: Texture manifest {name: {file, w, h}}, files relative to it.

src.description: Binary glTF 2.0 with embedded buffers and images; no Draco / meshopt / KTX2.

spawns.description: Named spawn variants. Pick one in Simulation, New game or a scenario (start.spawn); spawn stays the default.
